digest.component_or_area: Rebar application architecture and provider composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries
The ADR must record decisions on operation snapshot precedence, CLI/MCP/Python/service composition ownership, provider-native authentication injection, and subprocess environment rules
External dependency behavior claims in ADR 0098 must cite specific primary research sources and Rebar probes from recovery artifacts
ADR 0098 must preserve all unaffected decisions in ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 and amend only ADR 0049's per-job retrieval/composition seam
ADR 0098 requires a numbered Draft Critique identifying uncited claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts before maintainer authorization to merge
